heading: Three first steps.
intro: If you're reading this, something in you wants to change. That's the first step. Here are the next three.

items.title: Get honest with yourself
items.text: Take a free, private self-assessment. Answer truthfully. It's for you, and nobody else sees the results.

items.title: Show up on a Tuesday
items.text: You don't need to sign up or have your story figured out. If walking in cold feels like a lot, text Jon first.

items.title: Close the open doors
items.text: Install filtering and accountability software on every device you use, and send the reports to someone you trust.
